data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 玩具店
data.description: 【伊莉雅 · 玩具店】琳琅满目的巨型玩具店橱窗前，伊莉雅两只小手紧紧抱着一只比自己还要高大的毛绒泰迪熊，把整张小脸都埋进了软绵绵的绒毛里——「大哥哥！这只小熊长得好像 Berserker 一样可靠！把它买回家放在我的床上好不好嘛！」
data.action: 在玩具店橱窗旁抱紧比自己还高的泰迪熊，把脸埋进柔软绒毛
data.camera: full-body side view, complete bear and embracing figure
data.promptProse: Illyasviel embraces a teddy bear taller than herself beside the toy-store window, burying her face in its plush while its feet support its weight on the floor. Her white hair shows above the hug, cardigan, knee-length dress and flat shoes visible below. The full-body side view includes the complete bear against colorful window toys. Bright indoor light reveals fur ridges and dress folds, with deep contact shade between the embrace.
